thesis: The valuable wager is learning relevant states and reusable operations, not assuming universal simplicity.
role: Adversarial assessment of the initial intuition.

ideas.statement: Learning relevant state and compiling costly unfoldings into operations can be isolated as research targets.
Separate objectives expose rare-event loss, causal distinctions and hidden preparation costs.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Rule counts depend on vocabulary; equivalence, acceleration and discovering equivalence differ; no complete theory of mind is assumed.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
